structure.unit: Mandatory Sterilization of Dogs and Cats Adopted From Releasing Agencies

law.text:
This article shall not apply to:
An owner reclaiming his dog or cat from a releasing agency;
A releasing agency within a locality that has adopted a more stringent mandatory sterilization ordinance; and
A local governing body that has disposed of an animal by sale or gift to a federal agency, state-supported institution, agency of the Commonwealth, agency of another state, or licensed federal dealer having its principal place of business located within the Commonwealth.
